# safe-update

**Version:** 2.1.0 &nbsp;|&nbsp; **License:** MIT &nbsp;|&nbsp; **Status:** active &nbsp;|&nbsp; **Category:** system

Safe system updater - snapshot before updating

---

## Build

```sh
nix develop ~/0-core#faelight-forest -c cargo build -p safe-update
```

## Deploy

```sh
deploy   # sudo nixos-rebuild switch --flake .#framework16
```
